description:
Design a user-friendly data entry form in DHIS2. You are an administrator setting up a pilot program. 

1. Create a new Dataset named 'Vector Control Pilot 2024' (Short name: 'VecCtrl24') with 'Monthly' period type.
2. Assign this dataset to the 'Bo' district Organisation Unit.
3. Add at least 4 existing malaria-related Data Elements to the dataset (e.g., related to LLINs, IPT, or Malaria Cases).
4. Create two Sections for this dataset to organize the form:
   - Section 1 Name: 'Prevention Activities' (group prevention elements here)
   - Section 2 Name: 'Case Management' (group treatment/case elements here)
5. Navigate to the Data Entry app, select 'Bo Government Hospital' (or any facility in Bo), select your new dataset and period 'January 2024', and enter/save at least one data value to verify the form works.

Login credentials: admin / district
